profiles.label: Anchor — neutral male
profiles.instruct: Male, late 40s, warm baritone, broadcast clarity, neutral delivery, measured pace, no regional accent
profiles.ref_text: Welcome to the daily briefing. Today we look at the stories shaping technology, markets and culture, with reporting from our correspondents around the world. Here is what you need to know this morning, the context behind each headline, and what to watch for in the hours ahead.
